sources.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6: Pro, Flash MoE + Distill-9B same-day drop
sources.snippet: Xiaomi MiMo published the MiMo-V2.6 series on September 21, 2026 — not a single checkpoint, but a same-day stack: open-weight Pro-RL and Flash-RL MoE models on Hugging Face, a separate 9B Qwen distill for agentic RL research, plus API SKUs on mimo.mi.com that include a latency-priced Pro-UltraSpeed tier.
